title: Byron Bay Hinterland Driveway
description: Lawns are great, but too much lawn doesn't do much for the environment and it doen't add much interest to the garden. The idea for this driveway was to coordinate a combination of different elements, to bring vitality, personality and also so fun! A driveway does't have to be boring and uninteresting. In fact, it should be the first part of your house to welcome you back to your sacred place. This driveway offers space to wonder around, navigating the garden through stepping stones, surrounded by native ground covers. It introduces curves to fight boring straight lines, includes plants with different shapes, colours and textures, enhancing its atmosphere. It is however a clever planting, native and self sustainable, it looks after itself with little pruning needed from time to time.
